translations.web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
translations.bsb: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?
translations.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
translations.asv: Ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?
